title: Burned tokens can be re-minted into the `totalSupply`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low, as it won't lead to funds loss but breaks a protocol invariant/assumption  **Likelihood:** High, as it becomes a problem whenever someone burns their tokens  ## Description  The `FlorenceFinanceMediciToken` contract inherits from `ERC20CappedUpgradeable` and has a max supply limit of "1_000_000_000 \* 10 \*\* 18" token units.
